adds.title: Daredevil S2#6
adds.text: Foggy tells Mahoney that he and Matt have business with Castle, and Mahoney reluctantly lets them through to Castle's hospital ward.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Old friend Mahoney lets through to Castle's hospital ward.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Childhood friend on the force who lets Foggy in to see Castle.
adds.evidence: Regrets Only: at Metro-General, Mahoney (newly Detective Sergeant) is told by Foggy they have business with Castle and reluctantly lets them through. Also talks to Foggy and Karen at the precinct in Dogs to a Gunfight.

adds.title: Daredevil S2#11
adds.text: After Karen is attacked, Mahoney takes her statement at the precinct and puts her under police protection.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A friend Mahoney puts under police protection after an attack.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: NYPD friend who takes Karen's statement and gives her protection.
adds.evidence: .380: at the 15th Precinct Mahoney finishes taking Karen's statement and she agrees to police protection; he also calls Matt to tell him she was attacked.

adds.title: Daredevil S2#4
adds.text: Daredevil leaves the captured Punisher to Mahoney and tells him to take all the credit for the arrest, so the city can trust its police again.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: As Daredevil, hands Mahoney the credit for arresting the Punisher.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The cop Daredevil gives the credit for the Punisher's arrest.
adds.evidence: Penny and Dime: Mahoney arrives at the cemetery and Daredevil tells him to claim all credit for the Punisher's arrest so people can rely on the police. Mahoney later calls Matt about Karen (.380) and trusts Daredevil after being roughed up (A Cold Day in Hell's Kitchen).

adds.title: Daredevil S2#11
adds.text: Daredevil saves Claire from the Hand's attack on Metro-General, catching her as she falls from a window, and afterward Matt explains to her who the Hand are.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A friend who saves Claire from the Hand at Metro-General.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The nurse Matt saves from the Hand's attack on her hospital.
adds.evidence: .380: Hand ninjas attack the ward; Claire is knocked out a window and Daredevil saves her via a grappling line; Matt then explains the Hand to her. In The Man in the Box she takes in the Farm victims at his request.

adds.title: Daredevil S2#4
adds.text: After Grotto's funeral, Matt confesses to Lantom that he feels guilty for failing to save him, and Lantom tells him guilt is the soul's call to action.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Parishioner Lantom counsels over his guilt about Grotto.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Priest who tells Matt guilt is the soul's call to action.
adds.evidence: Penny and Dime: Lantom presides over Grotto's funeral at Clinton Church; Matt tells him he tried to prevent Grotto's death and feels guilty; Lantom says guilt is the soul's call to action.

adds.title: Daredevil S2#13
adds.text: Foggy tells Josie to close out the long-running Nelson and Murdock tab, and pays it off.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Owner of the bar where Foggy finally settles the firm's tab.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Regular who pays off the long-running Nelson and Murdock tab.
adds.evidence: A Cold Day in Hell's Kitchen: at Josie's Bar Foggy asks Josie about the long-running Nelson-Murdock tab and says they are going to settle up; Josie opens the register.

adds.title: Daredevil S2#13
adds.text: Over drinks at Josie's, Karen congratulates Foggy on his new job, and he promises they will always be friends.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Close friend Foggy promises to stay friends with as he changes jobs.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Close friend who promises Karen they will always be friends.
adds.evidence: A Cold Day in Hell's Kitchen: at Josie's Bar Karen and Foggy drink together; she congratulates him on his new job and he promises they will always be friends.

adds.title: Daredevil S2#11
adds.text: Marci visits Foggy in the hospital while he recovers from his gunshot wound and tells him his opening statement was so strong that her firm may want to hire him.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Old fling who visits Foggy in the hospital with a job lead.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Old fling whose courtroom work Marci praises to her firm.
adds.evidence: .380: Marci visits the wounded Foggy at Metro-General and says his opening statements were so impressive that someone (Hogarth, Chao & Benowitz) may want to hire him. They also meet at Josie's in Kinbaku.

adds.title: Daredevil S2#4
adds.text: Josie serves Karen, Matt and Foggy at her bar as they watch the news of the Punisher's arrest and toast to a safe Hell's Kitchen.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A regular Josie serves the night of the Punisher's arrest.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The bar owner who serves Karen the night of the Punisher's arrest.
adds.evidence: Josie serves Foggy, Matt and Karen as they watch the report of the Punisher's arrest (Penny and Dime); she also brings them water during the heat wave in Bang.

adds.title: Daredevil S2#4
adds.text: Josie serves Matt, Karen and Foggy at her bar as they watch the news of the Punisher's arrest and toast to a safe Hell's Kitchen.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A regular Josie serves the night of the Punisher's arrest.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The bar owner who serves Matt the night of the Punisher's arrest.
adds.evidence: Josie serves Foggy, Matt and Karen as they watch the report of the Punisher's arrest (Penny and Dime); she also brings them water during the heat wave in Bang.

adds.title: Daredevil S2#11
adds.text: Daredevil fights through Gao's guards in Chinatown to question her about the Blacksmith, and she tells him the Blacksmith's heroin comes in by ship.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Fights past Gao's guards to question her about the Blacksmith.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The drug lord Matt questions about the Blacksmith's heroin.
adds.evidence: .380: on Tower's tip, Daredevil subdues the guards at a Chinatown dry cleaner's front and questions Madame Gao, who says the Blacksmith's very pure heroin is brought in by ship, sending him to the pier.

adds.title: Daredevil S2#2
adds.text: Matt brings Melvin the helmet the Punisher shot, and Melvin says the whole helmet is compromised and he needs to build a new one.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: The craftsman who rebuilds Matt's helmet after the Punisher shoots it.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A friend Melvin builds a new helmet for after the Punisher's shot.
adds.evidence: Dogs to a Gunfight: Matt visits Melvin to check the helmet damaged by the Punisher; Melvin says the bullet compromised it and he needs to make a new one. In A Cold Day in Hell's Kitchen Melvin also gives him a billy club and fits Elektra for armor.

adds.title: Daredevil S2#10
adds.text: Matt visits Fisk at Rikers, accuses him of freeing Castle and threatens to keep Vanessa out of New York, and Fisk breaks free of his chains and slams Matt's head into the table.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: The jailed crime lord who attacks Matt during a prison visit.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Fisk's enemy, who visits him at Rikers and threatens to keep Vanessa away.
adds.evidence: The Man in the Box: Matt meets Fisk at Rikers, accuses him of helping Castle escape and threatens to use every loophole to keep Vanessa from returning; Fisk frees himself and slams Matt's head into the table; Fisk then has Donovan re-examine Murdock's file.
